review_notes: I read the whole file. It has no @[simp] declarations, no simp sets, and no simp-direction or cycle risks. The only simp-related candidate was `gε_eps`, which `map01_oneAddEpsMul` applies by hand. It is used as `have h2 : (gε g).toRingHom DualNumber.eps = DualNumber.eps := gε_eps g`, followed by `rw [h2] at h1`. That use is stated through `toRingHom`, not as `gε g eps`, so a @[simp] tag on `gε_eps` probably would not fire there. It is also used only once. `gε_comp_toAlgHom` and `stageHom_postComp` are used by explicit `rw`. They are equations about compositions and would be poor simp lemmas without more evidence. The `simp only [..., gε, ...]` unfolding is local and deliberate. The `attribute [-simp]` and `attribute [-instance]` lines are preamble scaffolding, not a simp-interface defect I can support. I did not run Lean, so I cannot rule out other gaps, but I found no justified finding.
